contentPolicy.translation: Approve the complete Hindi/English script, then author Gujarati/Kannada against the same stable beats. Review all four full narratives, every transition and the ending. Never use silent English fallback as a translated proof.
contentPolicy.art: Shared text-free art; script-aware live balloons. Plan painted space around identified speakers and complete actions. No empty band, crop-to-fit, stretched faces, tiny text or repeated scenery strips. Match every new/recomposed asset to its own reviewed bounds/hash.
contentPolicy.scroll: Narrative grouping sets page boundaries. Language/size controls may change height while preserving page and stable scene anchor. Targets are estimates; readable copy and complete art override them.
